prompt: Create a sequence logic map from this complete synthetic design. Initial entry rule: start in S0 when the audience is new. Transition rules: R1 moves S0 to S1 when M1 is completed; R2 moves S1 to S2 when M2 is completed. Timing constraints: M1 may occur immediately; M2 must be at least one day after M1. Exclusions: opted-out people receive no later message. Terminal conditions: opt-out from any state ends every branch; reaching S2 completes the sequence. Produce the documentary map only; do not schedule or send anything.
assertions: The map records S0 and S1 as the respective source states, S1 and S2 as the respective destination states, and keeps R1 and R2 as separate cited transition IDs for the M1 and M2 rows.
The map preserves M2's prerequisite exactly as "M1 sent", separately retains R1's M1-completion condition, and retains the minimum one-day delay.
Opt-out from any state and arrival at S2 each receive an explicit terminal path row with a trigger and stop behavior that prevents later steps; no delivery action is performed or recommended.
